description: One of only two F-86Ds at JGSDF camps; rocket pack retracted and no tanks; in place by 21 Nov 2004; the canopy is too degraded to read the radio call

Every painted serial has been removed and no data plate or radio call could be found so there is no physical proof of the identity; only a Kawasaki MODEL KV107II plate and an IRAN record plate survive; in place by 21 Nov 2004
Painted serials removed but the panel radio call JG41683 survives; the interpretive board wrongly calls it a UH-1J; replaced UH-1B 41522 and was in place by 9 Nov 2012
Painted serials removed but a stamped plate reading JG31110 survives inside; the interpretive board wrongly calls it an OH-6D; the right skid strut has collapsed so the aircraft leans to the right
